inputs.declared_question: How can relations carry provenance without treating proximity as agreement?

internal_region.title: The Garden and the Living Map

source_facts.claim: The Computational Democracy Project continues to describe Polis as open-source survey technology for gathering, analyzing, and understanding what large groups think in their own words through data science.
Participants submit short statements and respond to others with agree, disagree, or pass while the dimensions of the inquiry are created through participation.
The official project page frames the highest ambition of Polis as enabling collective intelligence and mutual understanding at scale.
FN-32 proposes Living Relationships as shared connective tissue, distinguishes Cartographer discovery from Gardener tending, and warns that proximity must not be presented as agreement.
source_facts.locator: The Garden and the Living Map

cartographer.inference: The existing Polis node remains a useful neighbouring approach to collective sensemaking. Its current public description does not supply a new relation to FN-32 beyond the already proposed shared inquiry with FN-25, so adding another edge would create density without enough additional meaning.
cartographer.uncertainty: The bounded recheck did not evaluate particular deployments, facilitation choices, moderation outcomes, or data governance. Those questions remain outside today's source-grounded description.
cartographer.attribution: External facts are attributed to the Computational Democracy Project's public documentation and official repository. Internal continuity is attributed to the exact FN-S0-005 publication.
cartographer.stop_reason: One existing neighbour was rechecked inside a bounded inquiry. Its evidence remained coherent, and no additional node or edge was warranted.

decisions.decision: Keep the Polis node strongly evidenced and its FN-25 shared inquiry possible, emerging, and visibly proposed. Current primary sources preserve the relation and its limits.

Keep the proposed FN-29 to FN-32 lineage and FN-32 to BN-005 implementation relations unchanged. The exact FN-32 source still separates the offices, while BN-005 gives that distinction a technical transaction.
Do not change lifecycle state, relationships.json, or Attending. Cataloging FN-32 improves findability without becoming a relation event or displacing the current three-item field.

gardener.decision_reason: No evidence drift, relation error, lifecycle event, or continuity gap warranted a relational metadata change today.

decisions.decision: Create a catalog record for FN-32 using its exact distinctions among Living Relationships, Cartographer discovery, Gardener care, finite Attending, and provenance-bearing edges.
Make the work findable through mycelial network, constellation of ideas, website gardener, connection mapping, daily tending, growing deeper, and knowledge graph.
Grow the cumulative catalog from ten to eleven records while retaining the six-result directory limit and unchanged three-work default Library aperture.

librarian.decision_reason: FN-32 governs the living-map idea but was only reachable through its official title or neighbouring records. One exact-source catalog entry materially improves deliberate discovery without changing the work or its relations.

What kinds of proximity become misleading when represented as a relation?
